$Comment: Fighting a boss to the end, won or lost. Target is the encounter SCRIPT id (the file name under Server/EncounterManager), so a step naming the boss holds through every phase. Fires once per participant when a fight settles either way, the defeat and the wipe alike, so 'fight it ten times' and 'beat it ten times' are two different objectives; Qualifier is the run's difficulty label and Amount is 1 per fight. Every participant counts here, including one whose share fell under the fight's MinShare. Leave Target empty to count any boss.
